programs.progression_summary: No week-to-week progression in the tab (single-week template, no week column, no %, no deload). Levers available: per-slot level (FOUNDATIONAL->MODERATE->ADVANCED pick), sets 1-8, reps menu incl. 'MYO SET', 'SUPERSET W/', optional days + Focus slots. Versus 3 DAY BUILDER: +87% main slots/week (15->28), +87% main sets at flat 3 (45->84); the extra day mostly adds isolation (biceps/triceps +167%, side delts 1.5->9, calves +100%). Coach's aesthetics track in MASTER_MODEL '4 TRACKS' (not this tab) progresses by +1 set per exercise every 2-3 weeks (2->3->4->5 or 3->4->5, i.e. +25-50% steps), reps waved 12/10/8 or creeping +6-13% within a set-block, deload WK7/WK8, '1-2 RIR'.
